test.script_text:
One of the hard truths about board appointments is this... (small pause)
Standard corporate resumes fail in the boardroom.
 
And no, this video isn't just about teaching you how to build a better one.
 
Because board positions aren't awarded to the person with the best CV.
 
They're offered to the person who's visible, credible, and already part of the right conversations.
 
In fact, global executive talent data suggests that nearly 80% of executive and board opportunities are filled through networks, referrals, and targeted outreach.
 
Think about that.
 
You may already have the leadership experience.
The industry expertise.
The track record.
 
But if your profile isn't reaching the people who influence board appointments, opportunities can pass by without you ever knowing they existed.
 
That's why aspiring directors need more than a strong resume.
They need board visibility.
Board positioning.
And a strategy to get noticed where board opportunities actually emerge.
 
Want to understand what makes professionals board-ready and board-visible?
Join our upcoming Board Readiness Webinar by World Development Corporation’s Directors’ Institute and discover how over 5000 experienced leaders are positioning themselves for board opportunities.
 
Register through the link below.
